reproduce.pipeline: The repo's own checklistinsider pipeline, end to end, no one-off script.
reproduce.step1_result: 1 page fetched, layout=tabular, 6,702 card rows read from the xlsx (CARD SET | CARD # | ATHLETE | TEAM | SEQ shape), 32 parallel rows read from the page's own Base Parallels List (0 diagnostics, 0 stub, 0 qualifier notes -- every rung applies to all 150 base cards uniformly, confirmed against the xlsx SEQ column card-by-card).
reproduce.step2_result: 1 CSV written, 11,502 total rows across 25 anchor sections and 108 parallel-rung sections (Base + 32 Prizm colors, plus Fearless/Fireworks/Fractal/Groovy/Kaleidoscopic/Top Tier/Pioneers/Color Blast/Clark-Mania! inserts and Signatures/Throwback Signatures autos -- every CARD SET value the workbook carries, split into base/insert-*/auto-* by the shared classifySections/categoryFor logic).
reproduce.step3_scope_filter: This package keeps ONLY category=='base' rows: `awk -F',' 'NR==1 || $1=="base"' <step2-output>.csv > 2024-panini-prizm-wnba-basketball.csv` -- the flagship numbered checklist and its full Prizm color ladder (150 base + 4,800 colored = 4,950 rows, 32 distinct Prizm colors, Pulsar /499 down to Black Finite / Gold Vinyl 1/1).

categoriesExcludedAndWhy.count: 6,552 of the 11,502 rows the pipeline produced were excluded -- every category other than plain 'base'.

breakdown.insert-base-prizms-<color>: 4,800 rows (32 categories x 150 cards): the SAME (cardNumber, color) cell as the 'base' category's ladder-expanded rows, derived from the workbook's per-subset sheets instead of the page's parallel-list ladder. Both signals agree card-for-card (spot-checked #1-150 across all 32 colors against the raw xlsx SEQ column). Restaging as a second category would double-count cells the 'base' rows already cover.
breakdown.auto-signatures / auto-throwback-signatu: 590 rows across 2 distinct autograph insert sets (Signatures #1-28ish, Throwback Signatures #1-37ish, own rosters). Correctly flagged auto-* by the converter's classifier; none landed in 'base'. Excluded -- own-roster autograph sets need their own registered keys, not done here.
breakdown.insert-fearless / -fireworks / -fractal: 1,150 rows across 8 named insert sets, each its OWN 10-15-card roster disjoint from Base's 150. HELD per owner ruling (WNBA never borrows NBA's ladder): NBA Prizm 2024-25 already registers `panini-prizm-fireworks` (250 rows #1-25), `panini-prizm-kaleidoscopic` (300 rows #1-30), `panini-prizm-fractal` (100 rows #1-10), `panini-prizm-groovy` (30 rows #1-30), `panini-prizm-color-blast` (50 rows #1-35) under `parent: panini-prizm` in productSetKeys.ts -- but WNBA's own Fearless/Fireworks/Fractal/Groovy/Kaleidoscopic/Top Tier/Pioneers/Color Blast are each 10-15 cards, a disjoint roster and count from the NBA insert of the same name. Reusing the NBA key would silently merge two different card sets under one address. Registering wnba-scoped keys (e.g. `panini-prizm-wnba-fireworks`) is additions-only, out of this package's scope -- see HELD section below.
breakdown.insert-clark-mania-*: 12 rows, a 1-card Caitlin Clark insert with its own colored parallels. HELD alongside the other WNBA inserts, same reasoning (own roster, unregistered key).

categoriesExcludedAndWhy.decision: Excluded rows are fully reproducible from step 2's output via the commands above; not staged, not discarded from the record.

heldSections.reason: Insert sets with their own roster need a registered productSetKeys.ts key. None of WNBA Prizm's 9 insert names (Fearless, Fireworks, Fractal, Groovy, Kaleidoscopic, Top Tier, Pioneers, Color Blast, Clark-Mania!) is registered under a WNBA-scoped key today; the identically-named NBA Prizm keys are a DIFFERENT roster (see categoriesExcludedAndWhy) so must not be reused.
